set.body: Replace any B x V filtered-null storage in production paths with streaming histogram/accumulator logic. Treat adjoin::bilateral_smoother()-style sparse graph filtering as an optional backend/comparison path: it is mask-native and elegant, but weights depend on the statistic map and must be rebuilt for each observed/null draw. Do not add a new neurothresh C++ bilateral smoother unless neuroim2/adjoin prove insufficient.
set.title: LISA: streaming null histograms and optional adjoin sparse backend
